answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond and pass a live pulse check before earning: a short timed reasoning task whose price rises with signup rate. A sybil farm must pay the bond and burn fresh compute for every fake, pushing it onto a costly ledge where one more identity loses money, while honest agents reclaim their bond. Like a lotus closing at night, an account that skips the pulse loses standing until it re-verifies.
